h.select_rule: Discard any hypothesis whose condition is the edited field's own current value, or whose condition merely disables or disconnects the edited component. From the rest, keep 10 with distinct mechanisms and field pairs, favouring those where an informed expert could plausibly bet on either direction.
h.strategy: Two patterns are banned because experts find them obvious: (1) conditioning on the current value of the same field being edited, which just restates that upgrading a weak setting helps more than upgrading a strong one; (2) conditions that make the edited component unused, unreachable or inert. Instead, each hypothesis must link two DIFFERENT fields that interact through a non-trivial mechanism, such as substitution between parallel routes, a capacity already supplied elsewhere, one part acting as a bottleneck for another, or interference that turns a usually helpful edit harmful. No condition setting may appear in more than two hypotheses. Use the gaps and negated assumptions as the source of each idea. In each 'why', name the mechanism and explain why the opposite direction is also a priori plausible.

hyps.why: If node 2 already sends an identity-like signal to the output, a second identity on 0->3 is largely redundant and dilutes the conv features at the output sum.
With 1->3 convolutional, the shortcut forms a ResNet-like residual around a conv branch instead of duplicating an identity.
A 3x3 on 0->3 already supplies conv capacity with no identity highway, so deepening the serial path is redundant and harder to train.
The final serial conv on the longest path pays off most when a residual shortcut on 0->3 stabilises optimisation of the deep stacked network.
Stacking two parameter-free pools on the 0->2->3 route with no conv between compounds smoothing into a useless bottleneck branch.
A 3x3 then 1x1 along 0->1->3 forms a cheap spatial-plus-channel pair, whereas without a spatial conv on edge 0 the 1x1 adds little receptive field.
Two identity routes into the output sum are sub-additive and dilute the conv signal, so a second skip helps less when one already exists.
Without 1->3, node 1's features reach the output only indirectly through node 2, so improving edge 0 has a smaller impact.
With 1->2 removed node 1 feeds only one output route, reducing how much a better transformation on 0->1 can propagate.
A deeper serial chain starting at edge 0 trains well across stacked cells when 0->3 provides an identity shortcut alongside it.
